title: Qualify bounded central differentiation and scalar RK4 ODEs
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded central-difference and RK4 numerical analysis contracts

contribution.summary: Qualify bounded binary64 central difference and fixed-step RK4 in Math analysis preview.5. Observe a compiled public API RED; pass 57 new GREEN, 203 retained analysis tests and two core regressions. Independently SHA-inspect the actual local NuGet archive with a new eight-probe differential consumer and a retained eight-probe C02 consumer. Complete C03-T1 only, leaving C03, W01/M6, rigorous error bounds, public NuGet and downstream adoption unqualified.
contribution.value: Add reusable source-free differentiation and scalar initial-value ODE calculations with explicit numeric step/evaluation budgets, typed refusals and noncertified error estimates while preserving previous curve, root and quadrature contracts.
debtChanges: Require one genuinely compiled reflection RED for absent derivative/ODE public APIs before staging the new source.
Qualify four-evaluation central finite differences with explicit representable step, finite callback values and heuristic h/h2 error estimates.
Qualify scalar forward-time fixed-step RK4 using N/2N step refinement, bounded evaluation counts and no claimed global-error theorem.
Observe 57 new independent GREEN, recover RED, and retain all 203 previous C01/C02 focused tests without changing their APIs.
Refuse invalid policy, unrepresentable steps, overflow, callback errors, nonfinite data, cancellation and unmet error-estimate limits without partial outputs.
Validate relevant numerics and composition regressions; avoid unrelated routine full-solution certification.
Pack a real local net10 1.1.0-preview.5 NuGet archive, inspect SHA/nuspec, and verify identical bytes in two independent eight-probe source-free consumers.
Complete C03 T1 RED/GREEN/V only. Preserve C03 T2, stiffness/events/PDE, public release and Decision/MCDM/AURA adoption as unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS085 success, prepare M6-W01-C03-T2 for stiffness, event and PDE exclusions, overflow, cancellation and local/global error policies; close C03 only after independent qualification.

achievements.achievement: Observe one genuinely compiled absent public derivative/ODE API RED on the qualified preceding version.
Deliver bounded central-difference and scalar RK4 methods with 57 independent numerical and refusal GREEN tests.
Preserve 203 earlier analysis tests and two relevant Math regressions, with a real preview.5 SHA-confirmed by two eight-probe NuGet-only consumers.
Qualify finite derivative and scalar ODE estimates with explicit noncertified error and resource policies; leave C03 T2 and M6 open.
